backup_restore.scope: Wyvern media ledger restart/revocation and bootstrap archive safety. Kernel/Volt own authoritative Adapter state; Updater owns encrypted host recovery. Workspace mode additionally exercises Updater recovery. Consumer logical restore is checked separately in each consumer test suite.

update_rollback.scope: Signed pinned bootstrap, immutable candidate, prerelease exclusion, installer publication gate and failure-before-promotion regression. Workspace mode also runs the typed Updater rollback/repair tests.

internal_documentation.reason: Wyvern has no own web interface or Documentation tab. On 2026-09-19 the owner explicitly excluded Settings/Initialize/update-card UI work; CLI/TUI operations are documented in docs/operations.md.

technical_documentation.scope: Current runbooks, recovery and release contracts, local project links and pinned central Part 12 catalog integrity.

security.scope: Negative authorization, redaction, bounded logging, source/output/all-layer secret checks, dependency audit and HIGH/CRITICAL image policy.

public_seo.reason: The headless gateway has no intentionally indexable HTML pages. Minimal health and authenticated inference/control APIs do not publish discoverable content.

private_exposure.scope: Versioned local/optional remote route inventory, Unix socket permissions, admin/data isolation and anonymous minimal health. Actual deployed TLS/external-network checks remain deployment readiness.

deferred: Consumer Settings layout and web lifecycle cards by explicit owner instruction; no own Wyvern web UI
Real-host activation, live provider and external ingress acceptance require their actual deployment inputs
